description: This file provides functions for handling version strings and directories, including parsing version components, comparing version tags, and retrieving sorted version tags from a directory.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts a version string into a list of numeric parts.

methods.name: compare_version_tags

methods.name: get_version_tags
